headline: Sensex and Nifty end marginally lower in Muhurat Trading session, breaking seven-day rally

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Profit-booking during the special Diwali Muhurat Trading session snapped a seven-day winning streak.
Losses in major IT and telecom heavyweights like Infosys and Bharti Airtel weighed on benchmark indices.
Investors paused after Indian equities posted their best weekly performance in six years.
Gains in pharma and metal stocks helped restrict deeper losses across the market.
whatHappening: BSE and NSE conducted the traditional Muhurat Trading session on Diwali to mark the start of Samvat 2083.
Sensex and Nifty ended flat to marginally lower, registering a red Diwali session for the first time in eight years.
Nifty closed just below the 25,000 mark after starting the session on a bullish note.
Bharti Airtel and Infosys emerged as top losers during the short trading window.
summary: Indian stock markets closed marginally lower during the Diwali Muhurat Trading session, ending a seven-day winning streak. Weakness in key heavyweights like Bharti Airtel and Infosys kept Nifty below 25,000 despite gains in pharma and metal shares. The small pullback follows an exceptionally strong week where Indian benchmarks logged their best performance in six years.
